title: Fix stuck bead loop: skip in_progress beads that cannot advance
description:
bv --robot-next keeps returning ship-1kh (in_progress) but Scuffy cannot satisfy its acceptance criteria. Scuffy works on other beads instead but 1kh stays claimed forever, hogging the top pick slot.

Fix options (pick one):
A) Change headless system prompt: if bv --robot-next returns a bead that is already in_progress AND was claimed by a previous session, skip it and pick the next ready bead from br ready instead.
B) Add a --skip-in-progress flag to the summoner that unclaims stale in_progress beads before spawning.
C) Have finishBead detect when closing a bead different from the one bv suggested and log a warning.

Simplest fix is probably A — update HEADLESS_SYSTEM_PROMPT in src/index.ts to say: if the top pick from bv --robot-next is already in_progress, check br ready for other work. If nothing else is ready, escalate.

Root cause: Scuffy chose in-memory storage instead of Prisma, so the schema bead (design relational schema) could not be satisfied. This is a valid architectural choice by Scuffy but the bead-picking logic needs to handle it.
close_reason: Updated HEADLESS_SYSTEM_PROMPT to skip in_progress beads from prior sessions, fall back to br ready, escalate if nothing actionable

title: finishBead tool: deterministic gate + exit
description:
Two companion tools in src/tools/:

**finishBead.ts** — deterministic completion gate. Params: beadId, summary, checks (optional array of 'typecheck'|'lint'|'test'). Default checks: typecheck + lint. Runs each check in sequence. Any fail → return errors as tool result. All pass → git add + commit, br close bead, log session_end, process.exit(0). ~60 lines.

**escalate.ts** — graceful exit without completion. Params: reason (enum: 'stuck'|'need_replan'|'blocked'), message (string). Commits current work (if any changes), logs escalation event with message, process.exit(1). Summoner sees exit 1 and pauses for human review. ~30 lines.

See notes/rebuild-philosophy.md for full design context.
close_reason: finishBead + escalate tools with signal-based exit, new log event types, agent loop exit check

title: Summoner script: bead-driven spawn loop
description:
Bash script (scripts/summoner.sh). Core loop: check .pause file (brake), check br ready for work, spawn Scuffy headless, handle exit codes (0=next, 1=pause for human, 2+=error pause). Single-slot with MAX_SLOTS=1 variable as hook for future multi-scuffy. ~30 lines.

Brake mechanism: touch workspace/.pause to stop spawning. Remove to resume. Allows human to deploy/inspect Ship at any point.

Exit code handling:
- 0 (finishBead succeeded) → loop to next bead
- 1 (escalate called) → print reason, pause for human
- 2+ / timeout → error, pause for human
close_reason: Summoner bash script with brake mechanism and exit code handling

title: LLM provider abstraction: support Anthropic + OpenAI
description:
Extract LLM-specific code from agent loop into a provider interface. Two implementations:

1. LLMProvider interface (~30 lines): createCompletion() takes our internal message/tool format, returns our internal response format. Isolates all SDK-specific translation.

2. AnthropicProvider (~80 lines): Refactor existing loop.ts Anthropic calls into provider. Uses @anthropic-ai/sdk.

3. OpenAIProvider (~100 lines): New. Uses openai SDK. Translates our tool format to OpenAI function-calling format, our messages to OpenAI chat format. Handles tool_calls stop reason.

4. Config changes: SCUFFY_PROVIDER env var (anthropic|openai), OPENAI_API_KEY. Keep ANTHROPIC_API_KEY optional.

5. Update loop.ts to use provider interface instead of direct Anthropic SDK.

Switch via: SCUFFY_PROVIDER=openai SCUFFY_MODEL=gpt-5.4

Files: src/providers/types.ts, src/providers/anthropic.ts, src/providers/openai.ts, src/agent/loop.ts, src/config.ts. ~250 lines new/changed.
close_reason: LLM provider abstraction with Anthropic + OpenAI, granular cache token tracking

No auth, no persistence, no sandbox. Deploy on Linode behind nginx reverse proxy with TLS (Let's Encrypt), pm2 or systemd. Target: scuffy.foramerica.dev
